business_summary: LAND Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate and renewable energy-related investment businesses in Japan. The company is involved in planning, developing, and selling various types of real estate, including condominiums and detached houses, office buildings, hotels, commercial facilities, and logistics facilities; and the residential land development activities. It also undertakes real estate development for renewable energy projects, such as solar power plants and biomass power plants; and provides real estate consulting and brokerage services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Yokohama, Japan.
